subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should explicitly configured agentDir files become prompt/bootstrap authority that can override workspace bootstrap files, or should OpenClaw keep workspace as the canonical bootstrap source and only warn?
rationale: The PR changes which local directory can supply safety and persona instructions, so correctness depends on a product/security boundary decision rather than a purely mechanical code fix.

options.title: Approve explicit agentDir precedence with safeguards
options.body: Require this PR or a successor to align doctor diagnostics, add focused regression coverage, document precedence, and provide redacted live-run proof before merge.

options.title: Keep workspace canonical and warn
options.body: Pause or close this loading branch in favor of a warning-only implementation such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653 or a cleaned successor.

options.title: Stage the runtime change and track follow-up risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the precedence change first, while explicitly owning the temporary docs and diagnostic mismatch as follow-up risk.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit agentDir precedence with safeguards
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a successor to align doctor diagnostics, add focused regression coverage, document precedence, and provide redacted live-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Val authored the per-agent bootstrap profile work most directly adjacent to this prompt-context policy surface.
